supply.source: CHAIN conditional source study, 2026-11-12; tools/chain/supply-study.mjs; hashes in docs/chain/supply-study.json; not C2 telemetry

assumptions.grants: 20 exactly; universal controls, opt-in sensitivity only. All bots claim in opt-in;5% nonadopter leakage. This is behavior, not enforceable Sybil resistance.
assumptions.budget: Candidate50% of prior closed-season organic burns.10% maximum earmark for conditional closed rank, remainder equally quoted to all cohort accounts for13 weekly bosses. All quotes respect deployed cap. Unused budget expires; no spending-based personal reward.
assumptions.organic: Model knows true bot labels and excludes bot-related burns from the funding measure; actual inference will be weaker. No simulated organic number is observed telemetry.
assumptions.rank: Rank is not a debt until allocated after season closes. All allocated rank capped to one weekly cap; equal boss quote reserves capacity for the largest rank. Week52 raw candidate rank remains conditional until next budget.
assumptions.affordability: Gross routine rewards saved for ONE feature, no grants, sale proceeds or other spending. An optimistic saving bound, not expected completion time. Share includes unreached accounts; conditional wait medians alone are misleading.
assumptions.statistics: 5 development +15 disjoint holdout seeds per mix. Candidate50% fixed before running. Seeds test Monte Carlo stability only; they do not verify behavior or demand.
assumptions.scope: Original fixed6 standard remains unchanged. Prototype candidate is not wired to the production issuer.

proof.inactiveGrants: With universal grants G and a persistent fraction (1-d) that never spends or transfers, retained grants >= (1-d)*G. Necessary: burn >= ((1-d)*G + treasury); reward reductions do not erase these balances.
proof.routineBound: For non-overlapping closed periods, allocated routine <= alpha * prior reviewed organic burn, excluding existing liabilities. With alpha<=1 and disjoint periods, cumulative routine<=alpha*cumulative organic burn. This bounds new spending; it does not establish demand or satisfy the grant-inclusive gate.
proof.recovery: Current SeasonRewards multiplies by zero after a zero-burn emission season. Later demand cannot restore a zero cap. No simulated or proposed issuer may override that deployed cap.
